description: This file defines a class 'DatabaseServerConnection' responsible for managing singleton database connections using Doctrine DBAL within the OrangeHRM installer utility.

classes.name: DatabaseServerConnection
classes.description: Manages a singleton database connection using Doctrine DBAL, with methods to retrieve and reset the connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the singleton database connection, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the singleton connection instance to null, forcing reinitialization upon next request.
